{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Male}}{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Female}} [[High elf]] | theater = [[Kalimdor]] | language = [[Common (language)|Common]], [[Dwarven (language)|Dwarven]], [[Thalassian]] | affiliation = [[Alliance of Lordaeron]] | status = Survivors regrouped into the city-state of [[Theramore]] and [[Theramore Guard|its military]] }} The '''Human Expedition''' was a league of [[Alliance of Lordaeron|Alliance]] military and civilian groups that fled to [[Kalimdor]] from [[Lordaeron]] after the [[plague of undeath]] and the [[Scourge]] decimated the kingdoms of [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Lordaeron]], [[Quel'Thalas (kingdom)|Quel'Thalas]], and [[Dalaran (kingdom)|Dalaran]]. They were led by [[Jaina Proudmoore]], who was determined to find a safe haven for her people. While called the "Human Expedition", the military forces had [[High elf|high elven]] survivors from [[Quel'Thalas]] and [[Dwarf|dwarves]] of [[Khaz Modan]] and [[Aerie Peak]]. Following the [[Battle of Mount Hyjal]], the majority of the members of these parties settled on [[Theramore Isle]] in [[Dustwallow Marsh]] under the wise leadership of [[Jaina Proudmoore]]. These forces would soon become part of the army of [[Theramore]]. ==Organizations== The Human Expedition was comprised of the following factions, the majority of which were active in [[Stonetalon Mountains]]:[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Cry_of_the_Warsong_(WC3_Orc) Cry of the Warsong (WC3 Orc)][https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Where_Wyverns_Dare_(WC3_Orc) Where Wyverns Dare (WC3 Orc)] * [[Lordaeron Brigade]] — A brigade of humans from [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Lordaeron]]. * [[Lordaeron Corps]] — Lordaeron's elite soldiers guarding the expedition. * [[Gilneas Brigade]] — A brigade of humans from [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]] sent by Prince [[Liam Greymane]] and Lord [[Darius Ravenwood]].[[The Prophet's Warnings and the Gilneas Brigade]] It contained many stout Gelnorian [[Dwarf|dwarves]] as well. * [[Kul Tiras Elite Corps]] — A force of humans troops from [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]], likely Jaina's personal guard. * [[Stromgarde Brigade]] — A brigade of human troops from [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Stromgarde]]. * An unknown dwarven contingent of the expedition occupied the settlement of [[Bael Hardul]].[[Patch 1.16.4#Shift in The Tides of Stonetalon]] As the factions didn't appear in any other missions, it is assumed that any survivors were assimilated into the Human Expedition which then participated in the missions in [[Ashenvale]], [[Winterspring]], and [[Mount Hyjal]].[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Eternity%27s_End_(WC3_campaign) Eternity's End] campaign ==Notes== * Opening the [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Cry_of_the_Warsong_(WC3_Orc) Cry of the Warsong] mission in the world editor reveals that the team name for the human factions is Human Expedition. * It was originally implied in ''[[Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos|Warcraft III]]'' that the Expedition was most, if not all, of the survivors of the Eastern Kingdoms. ''[[Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne|The Frozen Throne]]'' depicting human and blood elf survivors [[Alliance Remnants|still fighting]], but it was unclear if they were forgotten stragglers or part of a larger trend. The release of ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' and its manual confused the issue again by saying that "The few humans who survived the [[Third War]] fled south to the protection of Stormwind."''World of Warcraft: Game Manual'', pg. 168 despite also showing survivors of the [[Scarlet Crusade]], [[Argent Dawn]], [[Dalaran]], and [[Southshore]]. Concurrently, the in-game book [https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Old_Hatreds_-_The_Colonization_of_Kalimdor Old Hatreds - The Colonization of Kalimdor] implies that human survivors were in short supply on the Eastern Kingdoms mainland. ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Alliance]] [[Category:Organizations]]
